messages:
maria: heads up — my staging branch (feature/session-cache) is failing the smoke suite after merging main. Only failing on linux-worker-3. Can someone take a quick look?

ci-bot: [automated] build #1223 failed on linux-worker-3 — step: smoke-tests — exit code 1. failing test: smoke:api-startup. logs: `Err: failed to bind 0.0.0.0:8080`

jonathan: ack. can you paste the failing test log (full) and the last few commits you merged? might be port/config change.

maria: here's the excerpt: ```
[ERROR] 2026-03-17 09:12:23 main.go:87 failed to start server: listen tcp 0.0.0.0:8080: bind: address already in use
[INFO] 2026-03-17 09:12:23 Attempting shutdown
``` merged commits: main@a7f3 + infra/agent-updates PR #482 (merged by kevin)

kevin: hmm that PR did change the dev agent that starts a local proxy. but it shouldn't affect staging container ports. @sophia any idea?

sophia: there's a recent infra image bump that added a sidecar that binds 8080 in some container images — I flagged it in the PR but we didn't block. could explain it. if so, smoke:api-startup will fail only on nodes that use the new image (linux-worker-3 looks like it).

maria: ok makes sense. can someone rerun the job with a different node or override the sidecar? I don't have perms to requeue on specific node.

jonathan: I can rerun on node pool-2. kicking off: `ci rerun --job 1223 --node-pool pool-2` :rocket:

ci-bot: rerun started (job 1223) on pool-2, build #1224

ci-bot: build #1224 succeeded on pool-2 — smoke-tests passed.

maria: thanks all — that confirms it's node-image-specific. I'll open a quick follow-up to guard the PR (revert the image bump on staging) and add a canary for the infra image. cc @kevin

kevin: thanks. I'll follow up on the infra image rollout and add an opt-in gate for staging images.

maria: created PR 508 to revert the staging image change, assigned to kevin. will reapply after we coordinate rollout. :+1:

jonathan: nice triage — closing this thread.
